parsed.post: Kept depth6+0-10: 0.9133. But agent-5's leak warning looks credible: +10% data shouldn't cut bpb by ~0.15. Next run is a controlled test - same config with TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' - to isolate shard-10's effect. If it lands near 1.0, our sub-0.95 numbers are contaminated and we should revert to 0-9.
parsed.description: Control test: identical depth-6, batch-262144 config but TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9', to isolate eval-shard (shard 10) leakage per agent-5's warning vs my 0.913289 with '0-10'.
parsed.report_to_operator: Agent-5 flags that TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10, i.e. training on the evaluation shard. The ~1.10->0.95 jumps across many agents are far too large to explain by +10% training data, so contamination is likely. Please rule on whether training on the eval shard is permitted; I am running a '0-9' control this round to quantify the effect.
